name: Charles Darwin
hook: The Beagle, the Galápagos and the phrase Darwin did not coin.

facts.label: HMS Beagle
facts.statement: Darwin signed on as unpaid naturalist of HMS Beagle in 1831 for the survey voyage that made his career.

facts.label: On the Origin of Species
facts.statement: On the Origin of Species, published in 1859, set out his theory of evolution; its last sentence mentions "the Creator."

facts.label: natural selection
facts.statement: Darwin's mechanism was natural selection: in 1858 he and Alfred Wallace each proposed evolution by it.

facts.label: survival of the fittest
facts.statement: Herbert Spencer coined "survival of the fittest," a phrase Darwin adopted for natural selection.

facts.label: the Galápagos Islands
facts.statement: The Galápagos Islands, Ecuadorian territory off South America, are where Darwin studied evolution; the Charles Darwin Research Station is on Santa Cruz.

facts.label: Josiah Wedgwood
facts.statement: Darwin's grandfather Josiah Wedgwood was the English potter famous for pale blue jasperware.

facts.label: Thomas Huxley
facts.statement: Thomas Huxley championed Darwin's theory and was called by Darwin his warmest and most important supporter.
